parsed.name: Newport 1830C 光功率计
parsed.description: 用于测量光信号功率的台式光功率计，可进行波长补偿、量程设置、零点扣除、参考值存储和自动校准，适合激光与光学实验中的功率监测与定量测量。
parsed.description_en: A benchtop optical power meter for measuring optical signal power. It supports wavelength compensation, range selection, zero subtraction, reference storage, and auto calibration, making it suitable for power monitoring and quantitative measurements in laser and optics experiments.

actions.description: 异步执行光功率计自动校准，以断开输入信号并完成内部校准。
actions.description_en: Asynchronously perform the power meter auto-calibration procedure, disconnecting the input signal for internal calibration.

actions.description: 异步将当前输入光功率保存为参考功率，用于后续参考测量。
actions.description_en: Asynchronously store the current input optical power as the reference level for subsequent relative measurements.
